chief_thread_coordinator_unique.name: chief_thread_coordinator_unique
chief_thread_coordinator_unique.where: "chief_thread"."archivedAt" is null and "chief_thread"."projectId" is null and "chief_thread"."id" not like 'chief-digest-%' and "chief_thread"."id" not like 'chief-memory-%'

chief_thread_channel_unique.name: chief_thread_channel_unique
chief_thread_channel_unique.where: "chief_thread"."archivedAt" is null and "chief_thread"."projectId" is not null

coordinator_input_receipt.name: coordinator_input_receipt
coordinator_input_receipt.value: ("coordinator_input"."state" = 'consumed' AND "coordinator_input"."entryId" IS NOT NULL) OR ("coordinator_input"."state" IN ('pending', 'released') AND "coordinator_input"."entryId" IS NULL)

coordinator_turn_snapshot_payload.name: coordinator_turn_snapshot_payload
coordinator_turn_snapshot_payload.value:
("coordinator_turn_snapshot"."status" = 'sealed' AND "coordinator_turn_snapshot"."reason" IS NULL AND "coordinator_turn_snapshot"."redactionCount" = 0
       AND "coordinator_turn_snapshot"."payload" IS NOT NULL AND json_valid("coordinator_turn_snapshot"."payload")
       AND "coordinator_turn_snapshot"."payloadBytes" = length(cast("coordinator_turn_snapshot"."payload" AS blob))
       AND "coordinator_turn_snapshot"."payloadBytes" <= 2097152
       AND "coordinator_turn_snapshot"."digest" IS NOT NULL AND length("coordinator_turn_snapshot"."digest") = 64
       AND "coordinator_turn_snapshot"."digest" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
      OR ("coordinator_turn_snapshot"."status" = 'unusable' AND "coordinator_turn_snapshot"."payload" IS NULL AND "coordinator_turn_snapshot"."payloadBytes" = 0
       AND "coordinator_turn_snapshot"."digest" IS NULL AND "coordinator_turn_snapshot"."reason" IS NOT NULL
       AND length("coordinator_turn_snapshot"."reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 128)

mail_event_dropped_body.name: mail_event_dropped_body
mail_event_dropped_body.value: "mail_event"."status" != 'dropped' or ("mail_event"."excerpt" is null and "mail_event"."subject" is null and "mail_event"."displayName" is null and "mail_event"."fromAddress" is null)

schedule_target_xor.name: schedule_target_xor
schedule_target_xor.value: (("schedule"."todoId" IS NOT NULL AND "schedule"."chiefThreadId" IS NULL) OR ("schedule"."todoId" IS NULL AND "schedule"."chiefThreadId" IS NOT NULL))

secret_delivery_policy.name: secret_delivery_policy
secret_delivery_policy.value: ("secret"."delivery" = 'http' AND "secret"."httpOrigin" IS NOT NULL AND "secret"."httpHeader" IS NOT NULL AND "secret"."httpTemplate" IS NOT NULL) OR ("secret"."delivery" = 'plaintext' AND "secret"."httpOrigin" IS NULL AND "secret"."httpHeader" IS NULL AND "secret"."httpTemplate" IS NULL)
